81: The thigh: the most important part of the thigh - in Chapter "Sciatic Nerve", "Rabbi Yehuda says: [The prohibition of the sciatic nerve] applies only [to the sciatic nerve] in one of the animal’s thighs, and logic dictates that it is the right thigh." (Chullin 90b:16) He derives [this ruling] from the letter He of Hayerech [the thigh], and expounds: the thigh -- the most important of all the thighs.
